title: Northgate Mastercard Outside Rewards Program Terms and Security Deposit Acceptance
content:
**Earning.** On the Mastercard tiers of **Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.)**, purchases at merchants other than Northgate earn the card's outside rewards percentage of the purchase amount, net of merchant credits posted in the same cycle, and the cycle's rewards are credited to the balance at statement close, rounded half up to the cent.

**What earns nothing.** Cash advances, payments, fees and interest earn nothing, and closed-loop tiers earn no outside rewards. Rewards are not earned in a cycle that closes while the account is suspended.

**Security deposits.** A security deposit is accepted only on Northgate Secured Card.

Hypothetical worked cycle on a card earning 1.5%: outside purchases of 410.00 and an outside merchant credit of 30.00 posted in the same cycle give 380.00 of net outside purchases and rewards of 5.70, credited at statement close. A cash advance of 100.00 in the same cycle adds nothing.

| Cycle closes while the account is | Outside rewards for the cycle |
|---|---|
| active (Mastercard tier) | earned |
| suspended | not earned |
| on a closed-loop tier | not earned |
